maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue: Deep within the chamber, ancient machinery shudders to life. Iron chains rattle and heavy valves grind open.
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-10: The furnace roars to life. Fire bursts from the pits in the floor, swallowing the chamber.
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-12: Anything inside would have been burned to ash.
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-13: Event opening (The Soul Forging furnace has not yet been discovered)
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-14: Far below, rivers of molten lava flow between towering pillars of rock, casting a deep red glow across the chamber.
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-15: High above the lava, dark fragments float motionlessly in the air, held aloft by an unknown force.
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-16: The heat is intense, and a low vibration runs through the stone beneath your feet.
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-17: At the center of the cavern stands the anvil.
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-18: It rests upon a raised platform covered in ancient runes, surrounded by enormous dwarven pillars.
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-19: Its blackened surface is cracked, with a faint red glow visible deep within the metal.
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-2: A heartbeat later the furnace ignites. Fire erupts from the pits in the floor, towering pillars of flame roaring upward.
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-21: This was no forge for common hands.
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-22: Its power was bound to ancient dwarven rites. Rituals and knowledge long lost to time.
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-23: If any still remember how to awaken such a relic, it would be among the dwarves. And among them, only one name comes to mind.
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-24: Then the shadow fills the hall. A massive shape barrels down the corridor, scraping pillars, shaking dust from the ceiling.
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-25: Red eyes blaze through the dark. A giant, hulking and twisted by the deep, charging straight at you like a living battering ram.
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-27: Try to slam the door shut!
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-28: Stand your ground. Prepare to fight.
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-29: Choose “Try to slam the door shut!”
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-3: The giant bellows in sudden fury. Its footsteps thunder against the stone as it hurls itself at the sealed doors.
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-30: You hammer the button again and again. The gears groan, stone and iron grind as you force it shut.
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-31: The giant crashes into the other side with a roar that shakes the hinges.
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-33: Choose “Stand your ground. Prepare to fight.”
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-34: You brace yourself. The corridor erupts as the giant smashes through the last stretch of stone.
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-35: There's no turning back - only the fight ahead.
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-4: The flames rise higher. The roar turns to a howl, then a choking scream that shakes the chamber.
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-5: For a moment the iron doors tremble under the giant's weight. Then the pounding stops.
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-6: The furnace burns a while longer. When the flames finally die down, nothing remains inside but drifting ash.
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-8: A harsh metallic clank echoes through the chamber as a safety lock engages.
maps.points.west_dungeon_3.dialogue-9: A faded warning red rune flickers to life near the lever.
